central_argument: An energy-only work request specifies a budget surface; phase-dependent physical prediction supplies torque candidates, which are ranked jointly under input bounds and a soft arm penalty.

reference_style.scope: Introduction, problem setup, and method only

skill_sequence: nature-writing and control-academic-writing: argument, notation, mechanics, evidence
nature-polishing: flow, consistent terms, concise claims
academic-humanizer: audit followed by conservative prose revision

terminology.capture: Five consecutive sampled angles in the configured upright band; current endpoint
terminology.holding: Prospective sustained proximity to upright rest over a declared interval
terminology.requested work: Signed desired change in total mechanical energy, in joules
terminology.torque decoder: Physical-state prediction and joint candidate ranking
terminology.work surface: Energy budget plane intersected with the physical energy image
terminology.response curve: One held torque parameter mapped to endpoint energy coordinates
terminology.arm containment: Desired state property treated by a finite penalty, not guaranteed
